gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands tall, its lowercase lifted high with mouths left wide open. Noto Sans Lao, a plain sans, would carry a long passage easily, while Stentiga above it spreads its letters out in a hushed, luxurious way.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-lao-loo: Spaced-out and glossy, Stentiga draws every ring with a constant wall. Noto Sans Lao Looped does the quieter job, packing words into solid blocks with bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Refined lettering with generous spacing leads here, and Noto Sans Lepcha follows with stout, cast-iron lowercase and curves that stay open. Stentiga also looks best given plenty of size.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Hushed, stretched-out and level. Stentiga keeps one weight throughout, while Noto Sans Limbu has tall small letters and curves that gape, and a tiny heading would lose its luxurious spread.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian reads in a friendly, low-key way, with capitals barely above the lowercase and wide-open terminals. Stentiga is best at gliding along in one stroke weight; Noto Sans Lydian is best at quiet text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Noto Sans Mahajani reads tall and crisp, its lowercase standing above the capitals. Bump up its size a little if you like, and let Stentiga keep its luxurious, spread-out tracking untouched.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Approachable and sturdy, Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle of the line and gives its s generous openings. And Stentiga's hairline thread of ink, with no swelling, floats above it in refined, wide-set letters.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Flat, unswelling curves run through every Stentiga letter. Noto Sans Mandaic, a sans with lowercase rising near the capitals and loose, unclamped curves, is what gives this pair its strongest feel: refined above, relaxed below.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Stentiga's stencil-cut look, drawn in strokes of a single weight, sets a luxurious tone with wide tracking. Stentiga does the dressing up; Noto Sans Marchen, with proud small letters and open curves, does the plain talking.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-mayan-n: Stately, stretched and sleek. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals is a sans-serif with tall small letters and a c that gapes at any size, so a long passage in it would feel open and brisk beneath Stentiga.
